title: Fixed asset year end
summary: Work through the checks that close the year for fixed assets.

steps.text: {title} lists what to check before the year closes, for the {year} you choose. Each item links to its fix; mark it Noted to keep a record while it stays open, or Accepted with a reason. The year closes once every item is accepted.
Use {print} for a copy of the checklist to keep with the year's papers.
You can also ask the assistant what is still open for the year end.
